newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ATHLETICS-WORLD BEST FOR GEBRSELASSIE AS HE BEATS MORCELI.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WORLD BEST FOR GEBRSELASSIE AS HE BEATS MORCELI.

text.p: Haile Gebrselassie of Ethiopia set a world best of eight minutes 1.08 seconds for two miles at an international meeting on Saturday.

The race was billed as a head-to-head clash between Gebrselassie and Noureddine Morceli of Algeria but the holder of the world best at 1,500 metres, one mile and 2,000 metres was never in contention and dropped out at the end of the seventh lap.

Gebrselassie was well clear from just before the start of the fifth lap, after the pacemakers had done their work. But three laps on his own proved too much in his chase for the $1 million purse on offer if he broke eight minutes.
Philip Mosima of Kenya was second in 8:14.45 and Belgian Mohammed Mourit third in 8:14.88.
